assets.name: Cracking Furnace
assets.desc: Cracks naphtha into ethylene and propylene at ~840 °C coil outlet temperature.

assets.name: Transfer Line Exchanger
assets.desc: Quenches furnace effluent and generates high-pressure steam.

assets.name: Quench Tower
assets.desc: Cools cracked gas with water and removes heavy oils.

assets.name: Cracked Gas Compressor
assets.desc: Multi-stage centrifugal compressor; most critical rotating asset of the unit.

assets.name: Quench Water Pump
assets.desc: Circulates quench water; spare P-201B on standby.

assets.name: Ethylene Storage Sphere
assets.desc: Stores refrigerated ethylene product before dispatch.
